premises.text: Power outages are a significant problem affecting all socioeconomic classes in Nigeria
premises.evidence_span: 175 million Nigerians experience blackouts every day. And it's not just the poor, it's not just the middle class, but it's the rich as well.

premises.text: Businesses incur high costs to maintain backup power solutions due to unreliable grid power
premises.evidence_span: it costs four times the amount to run a backup generator than it costs to get power from the grid

premises.text: SOP Notify can provide real-time notifications about power availability
premises.evidence_span: we take low-cost Android phones just like this and we turn them into power sensors to let our users know when there's power available in their community

premises.text: Power companies can use SOP Notify to communicate directly with their customers
premises.evidence_span: our main customers are the power companies, and they can use our platform to communicate directly with their customers

premises.text: The electricity market in Africa is underproducing relative to demand
premises.evidence_span: the electricity market in Africa is a 27 billion dollar market, and they're only producing 50 percent of the power that people actually need

premises.text: There will be a significant increase in mobile phone usage in Africa, providing a platform for SOP Notify
premises.evidence_span: In the next five years, there will be over 1 billion mobile phones in Africa alone, and 600 million of those will be smartphones

value.text: SOP Notify aims to improve power communication and reliability for users in Africa
value.evidence_span: that's why we believe that SOP Notify will become the known power communications platform in Africa

notes: Pilot with Ibadan Power Company is excluded as traction.
